parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. get.description: List all associations of a specified object by its type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a given object, identified by `objectType` and `objectId`, with another object type specified by `toObjectType`. The maximum number of associations that can be retrieved per call is 500.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the object to which associations are being retrieved.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token used as a cursor to retrieve the next page of results.

link.description: A string URL that provides a direct link to the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of objects, each representing an associated object with labels. Each item in the array is a MultiAssociatedObjectWithLabel.

associationTypes.description: An array of association specifications with labels, detailing the types of associations and their corresponding labels.

category.description: The category of the association, indicating its origin. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', and 'WORK'.

fromObjectTypeId.description: The string identifier for the object type from which the association originates.

label.description: A string that provides a label for the association, which can be used to describe the nature of the relationship.

toObjectTypeId.description: The string identifier for the object type to which the association is directed.

typeId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier for the type of association.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to which associations are being made. It is a string.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
